tool_args.rationale: The fresh confirmation strongly refutes the fitted basin model, while the five training rows vary u_now and s_grad together. A high-s_grad probe is the lowest-cost informative option listed to separate sink-inhibition mechanisms from alternatives before proposing another model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The horizon is not short relative to the stated tau scale, and the supplied fixed-horizon data do not particularly suggest a coupled-memory ODE; this batch is less targeted than varying the sink-gradient regime.
It is explicitly nuisance and does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit a static basin/saturation model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 3.084455 versus tolerance 0.045 decisively refutes the prior fit; the input rows co-vary u_now and s_grad, leaving sink dependence insufficiently identified.
